Type the words from left to right. Your keystrokes carry a sword-dragging traveler through six hand-drawn scenes. He settles into a breathing idle when you stop on solid ground.

01

Space finishes each word. Backspace fixes a mistake before submission. Capitalization is flexible; punctuation follows the story.

02

Leap on instinct. Finish the word before a wide gap, then quickly type lowercase jump, without a space. You have just under a second, and there is no reminder on the path. A correct entry sends him all the way to the next word. Then type that word and repeat. This also carries you up the numbered steps.

03

The fight stands its ground. Words replace one another beneath your feet. Typing them drives blocks, ducks, and sword swings.

04

The light gives second chances. A slow or incorrect leap sends you down between the words and back to this scene’s checkpoint. Common story typos earn a stumble; bigger submitted mistakes cause a fall too.

Finish all six scenes to see the ending. Escape pauses, including a leap in progress. Reduced motion is supported. Classic v1 is available in the header.
